svg:
EyeKart Eyewear E-Commerce Platform — Data Flow Diagram (DFD) Level 0 System Context Diagram • High-Level Boundary, External Entities, Information Exchange & Payment Gateway Flow VERIFIED PRODUCTION SYSTEM CONTEXT React 19 Frontend • Express 5 API • MySQL 8.0 • Razorpay PG
0
EYEKART SYSTEM E-Commerce Core Application
• Authentication & User Profiles • Catalog Browsing & Multi-Color Variants • ACID Orders & Prescription Management • Razorpay Payments & COD Processing • Admin Catalog, Stock & Order Controls
CUSTOMER Shopper / Registered User / Guest
Interactions & Responsibilities: • Registers account & logs in (JWT auth) • Searches & filters eyeglasses / sunglasses • Selects frame color variants & lens types • Manages shopping cart (localStorage) • Saves favorite items to Wishlist • Submits optical prescription (OD/OS/PD) • Enters delivery address & places orders • Selects Razorpay Online PG or COD • Tracks order status & views invoice history • Cancels pending orders (restores stock) • Submits product ratings & reviews (1-5★)
Primary Consumer Actor Accesses platform via React 19 SPA web client
ADMINISTRATOR Platform Owner & Fulfillment Manager
Management Capabilities: • Authenticates with administrative role credentials • Analyzes live dashboard metrics & revenue KPIs • Adds, updates & deletes products & color variants • Configures product categories & brand catalogs • Quick stock updates & low inventory monitoring • Inspects order queue & customer prescriptions • Updates shipment status (Shipped, Delivered) • Reviews customer directory & order history • Moderates & deletes improper product reviews
Privileged Enterprise Actor Protected with JWT & requireAdmin middleware
RAZORPAY PAYMENT GATEWAY External Third-Party Payment Processor
Financial Operations & Security: • Receives server-to-server order creation requests • Allocates Razorpay Order ID (order_xxxxxx) • Launches PCI-DSS compliant checkout modal • Authenticates Customer via 3D-Secure / OTP • Captures Card, UPI & NetBanking transactions • Emits HMAC-SHA256 signature upon success • Provides verification callback to backend API
External Banking Service Integrated via official Razorpay Node.js SDK & Web SDK
SYSTEM (LEFT SIDE) -->
[C1] Account Registration & Login Details
[C2] Search Queries, Category & Brand Filters
[C3] Cart Checkout, Shipping Info & Rx Details
[C4] 1-5★ Rating Reviews & Cancel Requests
[S1] Auth JWT Token, User Profile & Role
[S2] Product Catalog, Swatches & Stock Levels
[S3] Order Invoices, Status & Rx Upload Status
SYSTEM (TOP RIGHT) -->
[A1] Inbound Admin Requests: Catalog CRUD, Stock Updates, Order Status & Review Actions
[S4] Outbound Admin Data: Revenue Analytics, Order Queue, Customers & Rx Files
RAZORPAY (BOTTOM RIGHT) -->
[P1] Payment Initiation Request: Amount in INR, Currency, Eyekart Order ID & Customer Details
[P2] Payment Verification Payload: Payment ID (pay_xxx), Order ID & HMAC-SHA256 Signature
RAZORPAY DIRECT CLIENT INTERACTION (Bottom Curve) -->
[C-P1] Direct Client-Side Payment Modal Customer Card / UPI / NetBanking entry & Bank 3DS OTP verification
EyeKart E-Commerce Platform • DFD Level 0 Context Architecture • Standard Yourdon & Coad / Gane & Sarson Hybrid Notation Verified External Actors & Live REST API Data Flows
